notes.title: Patch 3, I'm Back!
notes.notes:
Hey ya'll,

The transition to college has been a lot more involved than I had anticipated- now though, I have adjusted pretty well, and I have some time to begin working on the game again. I'm truly sorry for the delay in my roadmap and the radio silence over the past month, but know I have not forgotten this project. 

Today I released a really small patch that addresses an issue with ultrawide monitors, and changed how enemies interact with the starting rooms in a dungeon. Over the next couple days/weeks (I'm not sure how much time I will have) I will continue to work more on improving the enemy AI.

I really really appreciate the support even in my absence! I will be posting updates on the [url=https://discord.gg/TQb27Yy9rk]Discord [/url]as I get things done.

See ya!
-[i]CactusBall[/i]

notes.title: Version 1 Patch 2
notes.notes:
Small patch focusing on QOL and several bugs:
-Prevents AI from naturally navigating to Elevator rooms to prevent camping
-Made water drain from ship while docked
-Reduced frequency of BRKN enemy multi-killing
-Fixed a bug with jumping not working in elevators
-Decreased Dog damage by 75%
-Added indication from SAINT when going too high
-Fixed fuel loss indicator desync
-Added feedback sections to main menu and pause screen

notes.title: Post-Release Roadmap
notes.notes:
[p]Hello!

I hope everyone is doing well. It's been super cool being able to talk to some of ya'll about my game, it still feels kinda unreal that its finally out. I just wanted to come out and let you all know about my plans for the game going forwards.

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619647/8be4ee044b098fdb26bdbdef059d9afd42e78673.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]So firstly, I want to let it be known that I am just a couple days away from college move-ins, so my time over the next couple weeks will be fairly limited- but this does not mean that I am stopping development. I will still be diligently releasing patches for any bugs that are reported, and will still respond to anyone in the community.

Right now my main focus is ensuring the stability of the game. There have already been several minor bugs that have been brought to my attention- all of which have been patched. I will continue doing this until I'm confident that the game is stable.

Afterwards, I will move onto balance changes. You can expect some minor changes alongside the patches, but larger changes to progression and enemy AI can be expected to come sometime towards the end of this month.

Once the game is in a good state (hopefully sometime in September) I will begin working on Content Update 1. Me and Stardust already have some great ideas brewing up, and I'm looking forward to making them a reality. It is too early to share any details on what this update will bring, but that will be revealed over the course of the next couple months.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have any feedback, bug reports, or just want to keep up with the development process- feel free to join the [url="https://discord.gg/WqZxcFnYm2"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]See ya![/p][p][i]-CactusBall[/i][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes: Fixed an issue with getting stuck on an infinite loading screen -- Now entering a code less than the normal length will do nothing, and if the code is invalid, it will properly return you to the main menu. Also added some more content having to do with the survivor NPC, and a new model for the Harbinger (credits to Stardust).

notes.title: Eclipse Below is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]After almost two years, It's finally here. I have gotten the game to a state that I'm comfortable with, and am ready to share with all of you. The amount of work I've put into this game is insane- thousands upon thousands of hours making my dream game a reality- but the work isn't over yet.

Over the course of the next couple weeks, I will continue to diligently reply to any bug reports in the Discord or Steam community page, and work on making sure they are fixed ASAP.[/p][p][/p][p]After that, I do plan on taking a small break as I transition into college life. After that though, I plan on coming back and releasing more content and revamping old stuff in the game. Me and Stardust already have some ideas brewing...[/p][p][/p][p]If you've enjoyed the game, had some issues, or just want to say hi, you can join the Discord through the link below.

See ya![/p][p]-[i]CactusBall[/i][/p]

notes.title: Demo Available Now!
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]The past week has been pretttty busy. I've been working on making the demo available ([i]which it now is![/i]), and overall just polishing the game... maybe adding some new content- but that would be stupid right before release... right?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619647/806036e4ff3bfd6fabf62c41c58cd6bb8c0277a2.png"][/img][/p][p]I'm still on track to release the full game on the 30th- but until then;[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy![/p][p]-[i]CactusBall[/i][/p]

notes.title: Eclipse Below is Coming Soon!!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello![/b]

I can't believe this day is actually coming- I've been constantly working on creating this game for over a year and a half now, and I finally get to see my work put out there![/p][p][/p][p]If you haven't already seen it, here's my video explaining what the first year of development looked like- please bear in mind that this is the first video I've ever made; so the quality is pretty poor... I promise the game is better than my editing skills![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="KuXLVaskJ4o;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Anyways-[/p][p][/p][p]As this month goes by I will be working my absolute hardest to polish the game- I've already made such great progress in the past couple days.

Some things I've added over the past week are:
-New Music! Some of the songs that I've composed now play on the radios found in the shops[/p][p]-Lots of enhancements to visuals (especially with the NAV)[/p][p]-A Logs system. Logs can now be found in the world or generated by the onboard AI, Saint[/p][p]-Multiple endings to the game[/p][p]-Visual changes to all dungeon types[/p][p]-A new audio occlusion system[/p][p]-A revamped main menu[/p][p]-Many new models. There is now a lot less empty space in the world.[/p][p]-And so so so much more[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619647/4e634e5491ea0169261df4a50e943f2b50993f07.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619647/208fb54a5637164bccc141c8733dded05b08e633.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619647/dc3fb5ddf3f6cf151e473a0c69cde2d830c82902.png"][/img][/p][p]If you've made it this far, thanks for sticking around with me. As a reward, I'll let you in on a little secret... the NAV does not show the whole world- there is so much more to explore beyond.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again! I'm looking forward to release!
-[i]CactusBall[/i][/p]
